metadata.purpose: Source URLs the monthly pricing-drift check fetches to detect when 2026 industry pricing has moved beyond our spot-check bands. See scripts/_pricing-drift-check.js.
metadata.notes: Each vertical lists 3-5 representative industry pricing pages. Claude haiku-4-5 reads each, extracts the typical-installed-cost range it cites, and the script compares against the per-vertical calculator-spot-check baseline. Add or replace URLs when sources go stale or paywall.
metadata.bandResolution: Bands are resolved at runtime from the harness named in each vertical's harnessPath, matched by the pinpoint's harnessSpecId. The per-pinpoint currentBand field is a LEGACY hand-copied snapshot kept only as a fallback; it is NOT authoritative and was found 2026-07-30 to disagree with the live harness on 27 of 42 pinpoints.
metadata.scenarioAlignment: CLOSED 2026-07-30 (PRICE-DRIFT-FIX-4). Every askClaude prompt now describes the SAME job as the harness spec named in its harnessSpecId: same size, same tier, same region, same add-ons (gate, guards, opener, battery, packing, full-frame vs pocket) and the same cost basis (installed total vs equipment-only; patient out-of-pocket vs billed charge). Before this, prompts asked about generic national no-add-on jobs while the spec they gated was region- and add-on-specific, so drift percentages compared different jobs. When adding a pinpoint, set harnessSpecId and write the prompt from that spec's actual inputs.

pinpoints.label: 3-ton 16 SEER central AC, fully installed, Southeast
pinpoints.askClaude: Find the typical 2026 TOTAL INSTALLED cost RANGE to replace a 3-ton 16 SEER central air conditioner in the US Southeast (e.g. North Carolina / Georgia), on an existing home with ductwork already in GOOD condition (no duct replacement). Include equipment, labor, permit and removal of the old unit. Exclude equipment-only or unit-only prices. Return only JSON: {"low": <number>, "high": <number>, "sourceQuote": "<quote>"}.
